question: A next-generation probiotic is designed to colonize the gut mucosa by expressing specific adhesion proteins. If the host immune system recognizes these proteins as foreign antigens, what is the likely consequence for the therapeutic efficacy?

options.A: Modification of the probiotic genome to evade detection
options.B: Rapid clearance of the probiotic strain by the host immune response
options.C: Enhanced colonization due to immune-mediated retention
options.D: Induction of a systemic autoimmune disorder
